Reach the families and coaches who use Goalbound.

High school players and their parents come to Goalbound to see where players from their town went on to play college lacrosse. College coaches come to see where their starters come from. One sponsor per page reaches them while they are thinking about exactly that.

A text banner is a headline of up to 60 characters, one line of up to 100, and a button label. Image banners are PNG or JPG, under 150 KB, with the text you want read aloud to screen readers.

How it works

  • One sponsor per page, booked by the month. Nobody shares the slot.
  • Always labelled “Sponsor” and always below the content. Never inside a map, table or chart, and never on the coach tools, which coaches pay for.
  • Your link goes straight to your site. Add your own tracking tags if you like. Links are marked as sponsored, as search engines require.
  • A report at the end of the month: how many times the banner was seen and how many people clicked it.

Who we accept

Camps, clinics, club teams, showcases, tournaments, equipment and apparel, training, and colleges. Many readers are in high school, so we don't run ads for alcohol, tobacco or vaping, gambling, supplements or dating, or anything else that doesn't belong in front of high school athletes.

Book a month

Email tom@goalbound.co with the placement, the month and a link to your site. I'll reply with the rate and current traffic for that page.
